# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately via GitHub Security Advisories.

To report a vulnerability, go to the repository's "Security" tab and click "Report a vulnerability".

Alternatively, you can email the maintainers at [INSERT EMAIL HERE].

We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 24 hours and provide a detailed response within 48 hours.

## Supported Versions

We provide security updates for the following versions of our project:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Scope

This security policy applies to all code in this repository, including dependencies.

## Policy

We follow the principles of responsible disclosure. We do not tolerate harassment or retaliation against security researchers.

We will:
- Acknowledge your report promptly
- Investigate the issue
- Keep you updated on our progress
- Coordinate the disclosure timeline with you
- Credit you in our release notes (if desired)

We will not:
- Publicly disclose the vulnerability without your consent
- Seek compensation or other benefits from your report
